decision_context.selection_rationale: Compliance package covers both internal and external API surfaces that process sensitive operational data.
decision_context.naming_convention_summary: Sensitive-data fields and error codes follow namespace rules to support policy audits.
decision_context.threshold_method_summary: Compliance-related thresholds are derived from legal retention obligations and incident response objectives.

threshold_policy.latency_target_derivation: Latency thresholds are set from service SLO and regulated user-impact windows.
threshold_policy.availability_target_derivation: Availability target aligns with contractual obligations and regulated downtime tolerances.
threshold_policy.timeout_budget_derivation: Timeout budgets account for audit logging and policy enforcement latency.
threshold_policy.capacity_headroom_derivation: Headroom is derived from compliance-reporting peaks and incident-driven reprocessing.
threshold_policy.payload_limit_derivation: Payload limits are derived from data-minimization policy and transfer control boundaries.
threshold_policy.concurrency_limit_derivation: Concurrency limits are set to protect policy-enforcement dependencies and audit stores.
threshold_policy.retry_backoff_derivation: Retry policy balances durability needs with legal constraints on duplicate side effects.
threshold_policy.delivery_semantics_derivation: Delivery semantics specify deterministic processing and auditable outcome recording.

compliance_evidence.cross_border_transfer_control: regional data routing and SCC controls
